findings.value: These access lines come from the events hire site, not a guide to the bar. Number 90 Lock, one of its spaces, is listed as step-free with loading access. For other spaces, hirers are asked to contact the team about access needs, and accessible parking can be arranged in advance.

evidence.quote: Step-free, with loading access and flexible crew timings
Please contact our team directly to discuss any specific accessibility needs. From step-free entry to reserved parking or seating arrangements.
While the adjacent car park is private, accessible parking can be pre-arranged with our team.

not_found: accessibility.step_free (no whole-venue statement; only Number 90 Lock is called step-free)
accessibility.access_page (the hire site has no access-information page)
capacity (hire pages give capacity per room, 'over 1000' for the two combined studios, and no single whole-venue figure)
notes: Searched: none (WebSearch not needed; the venue's own site and hire site were enough).
